title: Joining two guarded run segments
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $q\in S$, and let $c,d$ be configurations on $x$. For $a,b\in\mathbb{N}$, suppose the run from $c$ avoids state $q$ at every time $v<a$, the run from $c$ at time $a$ is $d$, and the run from $d$ avoids state $q$ at every time $v<b$. Then the run from $c$ avoids state $q$ at every time $v<a+b$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
The run from $c$ avoids $q$ at all times $v<a$
The run from $c$ at time $a$ equals $d$
The run from $d$ avoids $q$ at all times $v<b$
replaced: If a run avoids an anchor control for $a$ steps, reaches a configuration $d$, and the run from $d$ avoids the anchor for $b$ steps, then the whole run avoids the anchor for $a + b$ steps.
